title: Redesign dependency graph
description: Redesign the merged dependency view through a user-led grilling session; use the supplied image as inspiration.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: Should the primary layout place prerequisites on the left and their dependents on the right, with directed connecting lines?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Yes: prerequisites left and dependents right, with a toggle for top-to-bottom orientation.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: Should the graph initially show every card participating in at least one dependency, including disconnected groups, while omitting cards with no links?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Show linked cards by default; provide a toggle to include all unlinked cards, disabled by default.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should users navigate a graph larger than the available viewport?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Use scrollbars and drag-to-pan, zoom controls, and fit to view.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should highlighting work when a person points at or selects a card?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Highlight the full dependency chain on hover or keyboard focus, dim unrelated items, and clear when focus leaves.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: What should activating a graph card do?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Clicking or keyboard-activating a card selects it and pins its relationship highlighting.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should a user open the existing card editor from a graph node?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Provide a clearly labeled Edit button on each card, separate from selection.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: What information should each graph card display by default?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Show title, ID, status, readiness and Edit by default; offer settings to add properties such as custom story points.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should graph display settings be saved and shared?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Save graph display settings shared in the board repository.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: Which additional card properties should graph display settings offer?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Offer optional assignee, priority, labels, feature and board-defined custom fields; omit empty values.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should status and dependency readiness appear visually on graph cards?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Show status and a colored flag border.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: What should the colored flag border represent?

thread.author: user
thread.body: The colored flag border represents dependency readiness, with an accessible textual description.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should completed, archived, and missing dependencies appear in the graph?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Show all; collapse completed, archived and missing dependencies to title only and open on click.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should clicking a collapsed dependency interact with pinned highlighting?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Clicking a collapsed card expands it and pins highlighting; provide a separate collapse control.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should a pinned selection be cleared or changed?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Click selected card again, click empty canvas or press Escape to clear; selecting another replaces it.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should existing board filters affect the dependency graph?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Keep the graph independent of board filters.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: Should the graph have its own search or filtering controls?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Provide graph-specific search by title or ID that locates and highlights matches without hiding other cards.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should the graph work on narrow screens and touch devices?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Additional request: offer compact layout like the reference and a loose layout keeping dependent cards in their parent lane, accepting whitespace; provide a 90% semi-fullscreen modal for more graph space. Details to clarify.

thread.author: user
thread.body: Desktop only for this redesign. Plan mobile separately in the backlog; it needs further grilling.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: In loose layout, how should branches and cards with multiple prerequisites be assigned to lanes?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Keep one dependent aligned with its prerequisite, place siblings in adjacent lanes, and assign shared dependents to one prerequisite lane without duplication.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should the larger graph modal be opened and closed?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Provide Expand and Close buttons and Escape to return, preserving selection, layout and viewport.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: When a selection is pinned inside the expanded modal, what should Escape do first?

thread.author: user
thread.body: First Escape clears a pinned selection; the next closes the expanded modal.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: Which graph layout should be the default?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Compact is the default layout; loose is available via a toggle.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should changes to shared graph display settings be applied?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Use an explicit Save button for shared graph settings; other viewers see saved changes on refresh or polling.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: Should graph display controls preview changes locally before saving shared settings?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Loose layout: when a card has multiple prerequisites, the first in its dependency list is its primary parent for lane alignment.

thread.author: user
thread.body: Preview orientation, layout, unlinked cards and optional fields immediately locally; Save makes them shared defaults.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: What does the full highlighted dependency chain include at branching points?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Highlight all transitive prerequisites and dependents, excluding siblings connected only through a shared prerequisite.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: What zoom should the graph use when first opened?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Start at readable 100% scale at the graph beginning; Fit to view is available.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should graph search navigate multiple matching cards?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Highlight all search matches, show a count and previous/next controls that bring matches into view without changing the pinned card.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should a missing dependency appear when collapsed and expanded?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Show Missing card and its ID collapsed; expanded explain unavailable and satisfied, without Edit.

thread.author: codex
thread.body: How should live board changes affect an open graph?

thread.author: user
thread.body: Update automatically while preserving selection and viewport whenever possible.

thread.author: user
thread.body: Shared settings: preserve unsaved local preview and warn on a remote conflict. Dependency links are edited through the existing card editor.

thread.author: user
thread.body: Conflict resolution: offer reload shared settings or explicit overwrite. Hover or focus temporarily previews another chain and restores pinned highlight afterwards. Use the visual graph only, with no separate text representation; retain agreed keyboard operation.

thread.author: user
thread.body: Recheck the latest shared version on explicit overwrite and warn again if it changes. Support shared settings in direct folder mode under its existing concurrency warning. Collapsed completed and archived nodes show title and status.

thread.author: user
thread.body: User confirmed the complete design and authorized implementation and PR delivery.
